answer: Gross margin fell 3 points in Q3 mainly because freight costs rose, not because prices or mix changed; renegotiate freight contracts first.
summary: Gross margin fell from 41% to 38% in Q3. The main cause is freight: per-unit shipping cost rose 18% after two carrier contracts reset in July. Price changes and product mix explain under half a point combined. Raw material cost was flat. We recommend renegotiating the two carrier contracts that expire in March, which carry about 70% of the increase, and pausing the planned discount campaign until freight is resolved. The operations lead should bring revised carrier quotes to the finance review on 15 December.
